name: Book jacket Bookmarks
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description:
Give a book you love a whole new chapter in life.
In this hands-on workshop, you'll transform the dust cover of a book you love into a sturdy, one-of-a-kind bookmark. We've developed a special process for uncovering the best parts of your jacket. We'll provide everything except for your book cover. Come ready to create, and turn it into a treasured keepsake.
Designed for adults and older teens. No previous experience necessary.
